card.name: Brian's sourdough bread
card.description: Sourdough from Brian’s in Atascadero. A crust worth tearing, a loaf that belongs beside soup. Butter is enough; the rest is optional.

meet_the_maker.name: Brian's
meet_the_maker.story: Brian’s Artisan Bread makes old-world-style loaves in Atascadero, using a sourdough starter kept alive with flour and water. The dough gets time; the loaves are scored by hand. Bread like this asks for butter, a bowl of soup, or a tomato at its best.
